status: accepted supplemental galaxy/star reference; F01 MIRACLE and NEW FELYSIA remain open
initial_state: data/CURRENT.BIN absent in each fresh disposable copy
steps: Copy data/, modules/, and dosbox.conf to a new disposable directory and verify the pinned input/config hashes before launch. Other module utilities remain present but are not invoked.
Launch DOSBox-X with the disposable root mounted as N:, switch to N:, cd modules, run NOCTIS.EXE; press Enter if the DOSBox-X boot screen waits.
In the ship view press r (onboard devices), 8 (cartography), 8 (show targets in range). Wait until the list has JEHOVABOH S08, a second S06 row, and ADELPHE S02, with ADELPHE initially highlighted.
Press Up twice, verify JEHOVABOH is highlighted, then press Enter. Verify JEHOVABOH, S08, and TGT FIXED are displayed.
Press Escape to close the list and Escape again to exit normally. Repeat from another fresh copy.

Run python3 docs/porting/fixtures/extract_current_target.py on the two data/CURRENT.BIN files and compare the documented little-endian target fields; do not compare the entire time-dependent save byte-for-byte.

exploratory_run.notes: A separate fresh-copy attempt sent Up/Return before target collection finished; it was corrected after the list was stable. It yielded the same saved fields but is not one of the two direct-sequence repetitions.

comparison_level: EXACT saved coordinates, class, RGB, spin, and radius f32 bits; TOLERANT starmap double ID; STRUCTURAL screen text
notes: Both direct-sequence repetitions agree on every saved target field. Complete CURRENT.BIN hashes differ, so those whole files are not golden fixtures. The screenshots are evidence, not pixel-exact baselines. The sector input was found by matching DOS's saved coordinates to the native sector function; DOS does not serialize the sector origin.
